page_title: SEV 2-1 ATM | Sevilla v Atletico Madrid 11/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' This is a yellow card! Peque (Sevilla) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+5' Isidro Diaz shows a yellow card to Javi Morcillo (Atl. Madrid) for his blatant foul.
90+4' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to substitute Juanlu Sanchez and he is replaced by Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla).
90+4' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Batista Mendy (Sevilla) replaces Akor Adams.
90+3' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.

90+1' What a wasted opportunity by Jano Monserrate (Atl. Madrid)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Odysseas Vlachodimos makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
88' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
86' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Atl. Madrid, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
86' The game has come to an end for Julio Diaz. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jano Monserrate (Atl. Madrid).
84' Isidro Diaz blows his whistle and it's Javi Morcillo (Atl. Madrid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
82' The attendance is 29723.
80' Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) attempts to release Alexander Sorloth with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
78' A substitution has been made. Ruben Vargas goes off and Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) comes on.
76' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sevilla, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
75' Having seen unsporting behavior, Isidro Diaz shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is the recipient.
75' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz had an easy-decision to make. Sevilla have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
72' The corner is swung in but Atl. Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
71' Substitution. Javi Morcillo (Atl. Madrid) has come on for Rodrigo Mendoza.
71' Substitution. Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Rayane Belaid walks off.
70' Luis Garcia Plaza prepares a substitution. Ruben Vargas is replaced by Peque (Sevilla).
70' The substitution is prepared. Djibril Sow (Sevilla) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Manuel Bueno Sebastian.
67' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
65' Total attempts – 10:10.
63' Atl. Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
61' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
60' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. Sevilla will take a corner kick.

58' What a chance that is! Isaac Romero (Sevilla) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the left post! The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.

57' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Juan Musso shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
57' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
55' The possession of the ball – 34:66.
53' Sevilla take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
51' Atl. Madrid are seeing far more of the ball now.
49' Rodrigo Mendoza (Atl. Madrid) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

47' Marc Pubill (Atl. Madrid) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
47' Atl. Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' The Atl. Madrid players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
45+2' 2 - 1 Ruben Vargas sends the resulting corner into the box and expertly finds Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the roof of the net. It's 2:1.
45+1' Corner kick. Sevilla will have an opportunity.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
44' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Julio Diaz (Atl. Madrid) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
42' Atl. Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

42' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atl. Madrid.
40' The ratio of the ball possession is 32:68.
38' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
37' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Atl. Madrid, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

36' Manuel Bueno Sebastian (Sevilla) has tested the patience of referee Isidro Diaz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge. A mid-range free kick is awarded to Atl. Madrid out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
35' 1 - 1 Goal! Julio Diaz swings the ball deep into the box and finds Javier Bonar (Atl. Madrid) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the left side of the goal. 1:1.
34' The corner is swung in but Atl. Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

32' Rayane Belaid (Atl. Madrid) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
30' Great teamplay by Sevilla as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
29' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sevilla, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' Isidro Diaz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Rayane Belaid (Atl. Madrid). A free kick has been awarded to Sevilla.
26' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sevilla comes to nothing.
25' Sevilla have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Sevilla can continue in their attacking effort.

24' A pass lands at the feet of Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sevilla.
24' Rayane Belaid (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for a foul. Isidro Diaz had a clear view and blows his whistle.
23' Atl. Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
22' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
20' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla.
19' Akor Adams (Sevilla) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Sevilla win a corner kick.
18' Rayane Belaid (Atl. Madrid) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
17' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
15' The Atl. Madrid players are exchanging some short passes.
13' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Isidro Diaz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
10' 1 - 0 Goal! Juan Musso gets a hand on the penalty from Akor Adams (Sevilla), but can't stop it from flying inside the right post.
9' Akor Adams (Sevilla) is going to take the penalty!
8' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Sevilla!
6' Play continues despite the shouts by some Sevilla players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Isidro Diaz interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
6' PENALTY APPEAL after Isaac Romero (Sevilla) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

5' Manuel Bueno Sebastian (Sevilla) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Juan Musso pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the left-hand post.
4' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
3' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Atl. Madrid will have the kick-off.
